name: flip-words
title: Flip words
description: One word in a sentence swaps for the next with a soft lift, pauses on hover and stops after a few rounds. Still under reduced motion.

props.name: words
props.description: The words to cycle through. The first one is shown under reduced motion.

props.name: rounds
props.description: How many rounds before it stops on the last word, so it never moves forever. 0 keeps going.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer inline element.

a11y.text: A screen-reader-only span lists all the words joined with commas, and the visible swapping word is aria-hidden, so the words are heard once and not on each swap.
The cycling pauses while the pointer is over it, and while focus is inside it (focus and blur on the wrapper).

Under reduced motion it shows the first word and never cycles. The setting is followed live, so switching it on or off while the page is open takes effect at once. With rounds above 0 it stops on the last word after that many rounds, and with rounds set to 0 it keeps going.
